reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: I’m extremely happy with this product. It arrived quickly, works exactly as described, feels well made, and exceeded my expectations. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for great quality.
reviews.zh: 我對呢件產品極度滿意。到貨快，效果完全同描述一樣，造工扎實，而且超出我嘅預期。如果有人想搵高質素嘅嘢，我一定會推薦。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: does not harshly irritate my skin like other oil formulated cleansers. great at removing makeup and even better when emulsified. beplain is great for not irritating.
reviews.zh: 相比其他油性配方嘅潔面產品，呢款唔會對我塊面造成強烈刺激。卸妝能力一流，乳化後更加好用。beplain 嘅嘢一向唔刺激，真係好。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: The texture is amazing. Even though it’s a cream cleanser, it removes makeup well while keeping the skin moisturized. I’ll definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 質地好正。雖然係 cream cleanser，但卸妝力強之餘仲 keep 住皮膚保濕。一定會回購。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: My favourite cleansing balm of all time. Non fragranced, fluffy and has a smooth texture that just glides across your skin when cleansing. Great for sensitive skin as it’s super gentle and effective.
reviews.zh: 我人生至愛嘅 cleansing balm。冇香料，質地蓬鬆滑順，潔面時滑過皮膚超順。超溫和但有效，好適合敏感肌。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: I got this to try because I use the beplain cleansing foam and love it and I love this one too! The creamy sherbet-like texture feels lovely when using on my face and I understand what it means to roll it on your skin now! It does a fantastic job of removing makeup and dirt and doesn’t sting my eyes. My blackheads are improved and my skin doesn’t feel tight after use. I now enjoy washing my face and actually look forward to doing it!
reviews.zh: 我因為用緊 beplain 嘅 cleansing foam 而且好鍾意，所以買咗呢隻試吓，結果一樣愛上！Creamy 似雪葩嘅質地上臉感覺超正，而家我終於明白「喺皮膚上打圈」係咩意思！卸妝同污垢效果一流，亦唔會刺眼。我嘅黑頭有改善，用完之後皮膚亦唔會繃緊。而家我連洗塊面都變成一種期待！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: ミルクバーム、すごく良いです！肌に乗せると乳化されて、普通のバームクレンジングよりマイルドなので他には無い使用感です！でも毛穴の角栓や汚れをしっかり落としてくれます。洗い上がりはかなりしっとりなので、乾燥肌の方はそのまま、私は混合肌なので洗顔フォーム(右)で洗います。ファンデーション塗る塗らない関係なく、週に2.3回のケアとして使っています。鼻の毛穴が綺麗になってきました！
reviews.zh: 呢款 Milk Balm 超好用！搽上皮膚會乳化，比起一般 balm cleanser 溫和得多，有種獨特嘅使用感！但毛孔嘅角栓同污垢都清得好乾淨。洗完之後皮膚好水潤，乾性肌嘅朋友可以直接用，我自己係混合肌，所以會再用洗面奶（圖右）跟住洗。唔理化唔化妝，我當每週兩三次嘅護理用。鼻上嘅毛孔而家乾淨咗好多！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text: would love to give this a higher rating but unfortunately my eyes did still sting a bit from this formula. i wouldn't say it's not gentle though! it's probably my own sensitivity 😭 i did not notice that this took off waterproof makeup well but overall did a decent job cleansing
reviews.zh: 好想俾更高分，但可惜呢款配方用落眼都仲有少少拮眼。不過我都唔會話佢唔溫和啦！應該係我自己膚質嘅問題 😭 我冇留意到佢卸防水妝效果特別好，但整體清潔效果都算唔錯

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Cleansing Milk Balm 100ml
reviews.text:
This is my first cleansing balm and I AM NEVER GOING BACK TO CLEANSING OIL.

CLEANSING 💚💚💚💚💚
Melts away makeup so easily! It even takes off eyeliner completely. I don’t find any residue even if I wipe my waterline with a q-tip. For me, cleansing oil always left some residues in my eyes.

EASY TO USE 💚💚💚💚💚
I love that the scoop included AND built in on the lid. It’s easy to keep the product clean and so much easier to pack this for travels without worrying about leaking cleansing oil or water.

NOT IRRITATING 💚💚💚💚💚
Wow I don’t even feel anything if it gets in my eyes. 0 irritation. Any kind of cleanser usually irritated my sensitive skin after a thorough clean but, this one really doesn’t.

NOT OILY 💚💚💚💚🤍
The balm turns to light foam very well (I definitely recommend using a bit of water to foam up the oil after lathering the balm for a proper cleanse). It does not leave my skin oily nor dry
reviews.zh:
呢個係我第一支 cleansing balm，以後都唔會再返轉頭用 cleansing oil。

卸妝 💚💚💚💚💚
化妝品溶到超快！連眼線都卸到一乾二淨。用棉花棒擦水線都搵唔到殘留。以前用 cleansing oil 總係會喺眼入面留低少少。

易用 💚💚💚💚💚
我鍾意支裝附有 scoop，而且內置喺蓋上面。容易保持產品清潔，旅行攜帶亦方便過 cleansing oil 或者水狀清潔，唔使擔心漏。

唔刺激 💚💚💚💚💚
即使入到眼都完全冇感覺。零刺激。以前用其他任何潔面產品，徹底清潔完之後敏感肌都會有刺激感，但呢款真係唔會。

唔油笠 💚💚💚💚🤍
Balm 會好好咁變成輕盈嘅泡沫（我強烈建議喺起泡後加少少水乳化一下再做正式清潔）。用完之後皮膚唔油亦唔乾
